purpose: The pack's type scale, read through theme tokens. Text is never sized by guesswork: every label names a token (h1/h2/h3/li/liMeta/sub/meta/badge/rowTitle) and a fallback for older packs.

anatomy.note: One line, ellipsis; includeFontPadding off so the baseline is the pack's.

copy.specimen: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog

rules: Labels are not focusable and never become D-pad stops.

behaviour: Weight is bold/regular only; no synthetic styling.
Text colour always comes from a colour token.

platformDeltas.ios: Map to UIFont with Dynamic Type where the pack allows it; keep the same relative scale.
platformDeltas.windows: Map to TextBlock styles with the same sizes and weights.

a11y.contrast: ink/ink2/ink3 each >= 4.5:1 against bg and surfaces
